query:
INSERT INTO attendance (appointmentId, patientId, familyUserId, therapistUserId, therapyType, scheduledDate, status, notes, markedByUserId, createdAt, updatedAt)
SELECT 
  a.id,
  a.patientId,
  p.familyUserId,
  a.therapistUserId,
  a.therapyType,
  a.startTime,
  'present',
  'Presença registrada para teste de relatório',
  (SELECT id FROM users WHERE role = 'admin' LIMIT 1),
  NOW(),
  NOW()
FROM appointments a
JOIN patients p ON a.patientId = p.id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Antonella%Salles%'
  AND YEAR(a.startTime) = 2026
  AND MONTH(a.startTime) = 2;
